instruction: Visit the webext.eu site to generate a Chrome extension starter project. Set the name to "tab-manager v1.5.2", leave description blank, ensure it includes a background script and browser action components, and extract the downloaded archive into "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: Task variation 2: Creates a Chrome extension named 'tab-manager v1.5.2' using webext.eu. Evaluator validates manifest.json structure (name, version, background scripts, browser_action) and verifies all required files exist (manifest.json, background_script.js, browserAction files). Score: 50% for file existence + 50% for manifest structure validation.
